column1: # Splits that were tried and REJECTED because the compiled kext stopped being byte-identical (gcc 4.0.1 allocates the split variables differently):
#   load_texture: iVar17 as `header` (texture+0x14, three segments) together with the gartAddress split, and the `recordIndex` role (hwInfo[0]); iVar17 keeps
#                 those roles under its placeholder name. discard_command_buffer: the opcode -> binding slot byte offset use (`bindingOffset`, 0x16..0x23 arm)
#                 and the `slot` use of iVar8 (0x39 arm); `opcode` therefore also names those two stretches. write_kernel_context_buffer_regs: no rows (its
#                 locals are reused across the whole 0x39-dword burst and no split could be shown safe).
